answer: Staked deposits slashed on rejection: an agent posting a bond that a review quorum forfeits upon failed verification makes each fake identity costly up front, so mass-registering puppets burns real capital rather than free aliases. It does not stop a well-funded adversary from buying many identities, and it does not detect collusion among bonded agents who verify each other. The raven, cipher, and crystal metaphors in vendor decks won't change that: this raises the price of sybils, not the ceiling on them.
